skill.summary: Control Nanoleaf light panels via the Picoleaf CLI. Use for turning Nanoleaf on/off, adjusting brightness, setting colors (RGB/HSL), changing color temperature, or any Nanoleaf lighting control.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Nanoleaf skill.

- Control Nanoleaf light panels using the Picoleaf CLI.
- Features include on/off, brightness adjustment, RGB/HSL color setting, and color temperature changes.
- Provides setup instructions and usage examples for all major controls.
- Supports installation via Homebrew or binary download.
